# `dunning_step`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

A dunning step the worker took for an account and O (once each): the guard that makes every step happen once, and the record the notification detector reads.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The postpaid account. |
| `overdue_since` | `date` | no |  | O: the first business date the account had an open, non-held bill past its payment due date (the oldest such due date + 1) when the step was taken. |
| `step` | `text` | no |  | reminder1, reminder2 (a message), suspend (internal suspend orders) or restore (internal resume orders once nothing counts as overdue; O is then the suspension's). |
| `business_date` | `date` | no |  | Business date (BILLING_TZ) of the step. |
| `overdue_amount` | `numeric(12,2)` | no |  | What the account owed past due when the step was taken, in its currency (0 for restore). |
| `products` | `integer` | no | `0` | suspend and restore: how many products got an order the engine accepted; 0 for a reminder. |
| `taken_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Instant from the injected clock. |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `dunning_step_check` | check | `CHECK ((business_date >= overdue_since))` |
| `dunning_step_overdue_amount_check` | check | `CHECK ((overdue_amount >= (0)::numeric))` |
| `dunning_step_overdue_since_check` | check | `CHECK (isfinite(overdue_since))` |
| `dunning_step_products_check` | check | `CHECK ((products >= 0))` |
| `dunning_step_step_check` | check | `CHECK ((step = ANY (ARRAY['reminder1'::text, 'reminder2'::text, 'suspend'::text, 'restore'::text])))` |
| `dunning_step_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (billing_account_id, overdue_since, step)` |
